_comment: Default (non-contract) terms compiled from the CURRENT policy documents. Each entry cites its source so answers can quote the clause. A signed customer agreement (contract_terms.json) overrides these per source-precedence rules in Support Policy v3 §1.

severity_definitions.P1: Complete production outage preventing all shipment creation for a customer, confirmed security incident or suspected credential exposure, or another event causing immediate material business risk with no workaround.
severity_definitions.P2: Major feature unavailable or materially degraded for a customer, but core operations remain possible or a workaround exists.
severity_definitions.P3: Minor defect, how-to question, configuration request, or issue with limited operational impact.

cancellation.source_clause: Cancellation & Service Credit SOP v4 §1 (Order cancellation)

service_credit.source_clause: Cancellation & Service Credit SOP v4 §2 (Failed-pickup service credits)
service_credit.credit_formula: lower of INR 500 or 10% of the shipment fee
service_credit.manager_approval_clause: Cancellation & Service Credit SOP v4 §3 (Approval and uncertainty)

rules: P1 incidents should be escalated immediately.
If a response target is already breached, clearly state the breach and recommend escalation rather than hiding uncertainty.
